reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Clairsense sign-in has expired or was revoked. Sign in again to keep your monitors available in Home Assistant.

abort.my_integration_required: Signing in to Clairsense needs the My Home Assistant redirect service. Enable the My integration (it is part of the default configuration) and try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Signed in, but the Clairsense account could not be read. Try again in a few minutes.
abort.already_configured: This Clairsense account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Clairsense account than the one this entry uses. Sign in with the original account.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out generating the authorization URL.
abort.missing_configuration: The Clairsense integration is not configured.
abort.missing_credentials: No application credentials are available for Clairsense.
abort.no_url_available: No URL is available to complete the sign-in. For information about this error, see the documentation.
abort.oauth_failed: Error while obtaining the access token.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out while obtaining the access token.
